Method.name: OnMessage
Method.Implementation:
#DIM stat As %Status set stat = 0 try { $$$TRACE("Create class for MMI: " _ pRequest.mmiNum) set cmObj = ##class(IHC.ITF.CheckMmi).%New(..JavaGateway, ..ApplicationAddress) $$$TRACE("Created the object") set stat = cmObj.MMiexists(pRequest.mmiNum) $$$TRACE( "CheckMMI: " _ stat) set pResponse = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.CheckMmiStructure).%New() set pResponse.found = stat set pResponse.mmiNum = pRequest.mmiNum set stat = $$$OK
} CATCH errobj { $$$LOGERROR( "Error in CheckMMI: " _ errobj.AsSystemError() _ " _ data: " _ errobj.Data _ "; code:" _ errobj.Code) set stat = $$$ERROR("Exception in CheckMMI: " _ errobj.AsSystemError() _ " _ data: " _ errobj.Data _ "; code:" _ errobj.Code) } return stat
